title: Our School
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Safety on the way to school: walk with others, keep to the side of the road facing traffic, never go with strangers (SAFE).

skills.key_step: The child names the main physical features between home and school and uses them to say where places are.

floor.question: Name a place near your home.

representations: a large drawn path from home to school
steps: Name what you pass on the way.
Put the features on the path.
Say which are natural and which people made.
Use features to tell where your home is.
contexts: a visitor looking for the school

board.do: Draw a path from a house to a school with a river and a church.
Wait for the child to say a river.
Label each feature on the path.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a feature on the way to school: a bridge or a dog?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: will it be there tomorrow? Features stay in one place.

misconceptions.ask: Is a desk a feature on the way between home and school?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a path from a house to a school. Only things along the path count.

listen_for: No, it is just the way
misconceptions.repair: Point to the road on the drawing and name it.

misconceptions.ask: Do all children pass the same things on the way to school?
misconceptions.repair: Let three children draw their way. Compare the features.

checks.question: Name a feature between home and school.

skills.key_step: The child says how to keep safe on the way to school: walk with others, keep to the side, cross carefully, go straight home, never go with strangers.

floor.question: Is it safe to play near a road?

representations: a chalk road in the field
steps: Say the safe action for each.
Practise saying no to a stranger.
contexts: a busy market day on the road

board.do: Draw a child alone and a car on the road.

board.say: Is the child safe? What should she do?

board.do: Wait for the child to say walk on the side, with friends.
Write: walk with friends, keep to the side, look before crossing.

listen_for: Take them and say thank you
misconceptions.ask: A stranger offers you sweets on the way home. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play saying "No, thank you" and walking to a trusted adult.

listen_for: Yes, there are no cars now
misconceptions.ask: Is a quiet road a good place to play?
misconceptions.repair: Show how fast a boda boda comes round a bend. Play only in safe places.

misconceptions.ask: How should you cross a road?
misconceptions.repair: Practise on a chalk road: stop, look, listen, walk.

listen_for: Play on the way and go home later
misconceptions.ask: After school, what should you do?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about parents worrying and dangers after dark. Agree: go straight home.

checks.question: Should you take sweets from a stranger?
What do you do before crossing a road?
